text:
maya: Kicking off a replay run with cohort-aware sampling + deterministic anonymizer. Targeting KV prefetch behavior and kernel selection differences. Posting config so folks can follow.

maya: ```
replay_campaign: cohort-probe-2026-03
sampling: stratified
sample_rate: 0.10
per_user_cap: 3
anonymizer: prefix-hash-v2
anonymizer_seed: <redacted>
kernel_policy: auto
kv_warmup: full
batching: baseline
metrics: token_parity, logits_corr, p50_latency, p95_latency, kv_hit_rate
```

replay-bot: Job started: replay-run/2945007654 - cohort-probe-2026-03 (wave 1). ETA ~45m. Logs -> s3://replays/in-progress/2945007654/

alex: Quick q — confirm anonymizer_seed is deterministic across waves? we need exact same salt for parity checks.

maya: yes. seed will be pinned (I'll publish once seeded). anonymizer is non-reversible, preserves relative prefix grouping only.

sam: Sampling details: stratified by product segment (api vs dedicated) + length buckets. 10% overall, capped 3 queries per user per day to avoid heavy-user skew. preserves seq-length histogram.

jit: Important: when kernel_policy=auto the runtime may pick different matmul kernels depending on occupancy. That can change low-level float arithmetic and break token-level parity. Plan: run pairs (kernel=auto vs kernel=fast-matmul) with identical seeds and cache state. compute token-level diff rate and top-k logits correlation.

maya: Agreed. wave plan:
- wave A: kernel=auto (baseline)
- wave B: kernel=fast-matmul (candidate)
Collect: token_parity_rate, logits_corr, p50/p95 latency, GPU util, kv_hit_rate per cohort.

alex: Also, last week we saw KV warmup mismatch because some traces get prefetched differently. Set kv_warmup=full and kv-prefetch-policy=deterministic so prefetch ordering matches.

maya: done. kv-prefetch-policy pinned to deterministic.

replay-bot: Wave A complete. summary -> token_parity_rate=0.0024, logits_corr=0.9971, p95_latency=324ms (+12ms vs baseline), kv_hit_rate=0.87

maya: :eyes: small but not zero parity. can someone run a logits-drift breakdown by token position?

sam: On it. will run correlation by prefix-length and top-3 logit delta. suspect rounding in kernel fast path.

alex: I pushed anonymizer_seed=482931 into campaign config. also bumped telemetry sampling to 100% for these runs.

jit: If logits_corr < 0.999, we should consider whether quantization heuristics or kernel reorderings are changing attention accumulation. Logging attention-sum checks helps isolate.

ops-bot: Perf trace uploaded: s3://redwood-replay/2945007654/waveA/perf_trace.json.gz (GPU timelines + kernel selection table)

maya: Thanks. I'll run compare_replay.py against the gold run:
```
python tools/compare_replay.py --gold s3://gold/replays/2944000000 --run s3://replays/in-progress/2945007654 --out /tmp/294500_cmp.json
```

replay-bot: Wave B (kernel=fast-matmul, batching=tuned-prefetch) started: replay-run/2945007654/waveB

replay-bot: Wave B complete. summary -> token_parity_rate=0.0051, logits_corr=0.9934, p95_latency=311ms (-13ms), kv_hit_rate=0.84

sam: Huh larger parity delta on B even though latency improved. that points to kernel fp differences not caching.

maya: We need token-level diffs for the subset where kv_hit_rate differs a lot. also check whether prefetched KV ordering changed any prefixes.

alex: Ran a quick sample: top-5 logits overlap still 98.9% but some high-entropy prompts diverge. Attaching subset to s3.

jit: Recommendation: add attention checksum to the trace at each layer for a small cohort (100 traces). checksums are cheap and will reveal layer-level drift source.

maya: Adding attention checks for wave C. Also enabling kernel-env-var to force deterministic matmul fallback for debug.

ops-bot: Uploaded wave-level metrics and raw diffs: s3://redwood-replay/2945007654/summary/{waveA,waveB}.json

maya: Thanks all. Action items:
- sam: run logits-corr by position + attach diff examples (low/high entropy)
- jit: prototype attention-checksum instrumentation (small cohort)
- alex: confirm anonymizer seed pinned in all exported manifests
- ops: capture GPU kernel selection table and KV prefetch ordering snapshot

maya: Plan to reconvene once attention checks are in (target in 24h). If parity > 0.01 we fail the kernel switch. Otherwise proceed with staged canary.

alex: scheduling follow-up thread when waveC finishes.

replay-bot: Wave C (debug, deterministic-matmul) scheduled: 2945011254

maya: cool. thanks everyone.
